column3: Topic: rounded shoulders from the phone; wall angels and doorway chest stretch. Hook: "Rounded shoulders?" Art style: elegant watercolor and ink illustration on warm off-white paper. Voice: ash.
Topic: back stiff after sitting all day; cat-cow and child's pose. Hook: "Back stiff after school?" Art style: clean flat vector illustration, soft pastel colors, light grey background. Voice: verse.
Topic: decompress your spine; dead hang and cobra stretch. Hook: "Your spine shrinks every day." Art style: bold anime illustration, cel shading, clean white background. Voice: echo.
Topic: forward head posture (text neck); chin tucks and neck side stretch. Hook: "Head pokes forward?" Art style: realistic 3D render, soft studio light, light blue background. Voice: cedar.

Topic: tight hips from sitting tilt the pelvis and make you look shorter; kneeling hip flexor stretch and glute bridge. Hook: "Sitting all day?" Art style: graphic comic style with bold black ink lines and halftone shading, cream background. Voice: echo.

Topic: 2-minute morning posture routine; standing overhead reach and wall stand. Hook: "Do this every morning." Art style: dreamy pastel synthwave illustration, soft gradients, lavender background. Voice: marin.

Topic: before bed stretch to relax the spine; supine twist and knees-to-chest. Hook: "Can't sleep straight?" Art style: cozy children's-book gouache illustration, warm night colors, deep blue background. Voice: sage.
Topic: weak core makes you slouch; plank and bird dog. Hook: "Always slouching?" Art style: bold pop-art flat illustration, bright yellow background, thick outlines. Voice: coral.

Topic: hamstrings so tight you can't stand straight; standing forward fold and seated hamstring stretch. Hook: "Can't touch your toes?" Art style: dynamic manga ink illustration with speed lines, white background. Voice: ash.

Topic: upper back strength for tall posture; superman Y-raise and reverse snow angels lying face down. Hook: "Want to stand taller?" Art style: playful 3D clay render, soft shadows, mint green background. Voice: ballad.
